body: **Foco:** Concessive structures (Much as I admire…) — prática e contraste.

**22 palavras novas** (negociações).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar although, despite, much as e as + adjetivo em um editorial.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: The Limits of Compromise
paras: **Much as** we respect the mayor’s patience, a deal that pleases everyone usually pleases no one. **Cautious as** the unions have been, they have won little. **Although** talks have lasted a year, and **despite** repeated promises, nothing has been signed.

**Whatever** the outcome, **however** long it takes, the city must not let the process drag on. **Hard as** it is to say, **granted that** both sides have made concessions, **the fact remains** that the workers are waiting.

items.q: The editors respect the mayor’s patience.
The editors want the process to drag on.
items.why: must not let it drag on.

blocks.body: **Although** e **despite** significam o mesmo, mas **although** leva oração e **despite** leva substantivo ou -ing: *Although it rained* / *Despite the rain* / *Despite raining*.

items.s: ___ talks lasted a year, nothing was signed. (Although)
Cautious ___ the unions are, they have won little. (as)
However long it ___ , we must finish. (take)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **The fact remains that…** — O fato é que…
**Granted that…** — Admitindo que…
**Drag on** — Arrastar-se
**Reach a deadlock** — Chegar a um impasse
**Break the impasse** — Romper o impasse
**Sign on the dotted line** — Assinar o acordo
**Hammer out a deal** — Fechar um acordo com esforço
**Split the difference** — Dividir a diferença
**Same meaning?** — Mesmo sentido?
**Although the talks lasted a year, nothing was signed.** — Embora as conversas tenham durado um ano, nada foi assinado.
**Despite the long talks, there is no deal.** — Apesar das longas conversas, não há acordo.

blocks.title: Debate club
lines: Although the talks lasted a year, nothing was signed.
Embora as conversas tenham durado um ano, nada foi assinado.
Despite the long talks, there is no deal.
Apesar das longas conversas, não há acordo.
Yes, but “although” takes a clause and “despite” takes a noun.
Sim, mas “although” leva oração e “despite” leva substantivo.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.model: Although the talks were long, nothing was signed.
Despite the long talks, nothing was signed.
Tired as I was, I kept working.

blocks.task: Rewrite 3 sentences in three ways each (although / despite / adj + as) and write a 3-sentence editorial conclusion.
blocks.model: Although it was cold, we walked. Despite the cold, we walked. Cold as it was, we walked. Although he was paid less, he stayed. Despite being paid less, he stayed. Underpaid as he was, he stayed. Conclusion: Much as we respect the mayor, we ask for a deal by Friday.

items.why: **public sector pay** = salário do setor público.
